scenes.label: WHICH MUSCLES DO PUSH-UPS REALLY BUILD?
scenes.say: Push-ups are the most popular home exercise. But which muscles do they really build? Let's break it down, one by one.

scenes.note: PUSHES YOU UP ON EVERY REP
scenes.label: CHEST
scenes.say: The first muscle is your chest. It pushes your body up on every rep, that's why you feel it the most.

scenes.label: TRICEPS
scenes.say: Second, the triceps, at the back of your arm. They straighten your elbow at the top.

scenes.label: TRICEPS FROM BEHIND
scenes.say: Your triceps make up about two thirds of your arm size, so don't skip them.

scenes.label: FRONT DELTS
scenes.say: Third, your front delts. They help your chest push.

scenes.label: ABS
scenes.say: Your abs work like a belt. They stop your hips from sagging and keep your body straight.

scenes.note: DON'T EXPECT BIG ARMS FROM PUSH-UPS ALONE
scenes.label: BICEPS BARELY WORK
scenes.say: Common mistake: your biceps barely work in push-ups, so don't expect big arms from them alone.

scenes.label: CHEST + TRICEPS + SHOULDERS + ABS
scenes.say: So push-ups build your chest, triceps, shoulders and abs. Subscribe for more workouts.
